BM03.label: Treasury watch

BM19.notice: Keep the passage clear for companions. Injuries lead to care, and young soldiers are never disposable units.

BM24.label: Protect the passage
BM24.notice: Hold the passage while people withdraw. Rally, guard and make space for the record; Cumorah cannot become a victory arena.
